definitions: A plant of the dock family, with large leaves and thick, reddish, edible leaf stalks.
The edible stalks of the rhubarb plant, typically cooked and used in desserts or as a tart flavouring.
A heated argument or dispute, especially in a sporting context.
examples: Rhubarb crumble is a classic British dessert.
The umpire had a bit of a rhubarb with the coach.
She planted rhubarb in her garden last spring.
